faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I need to pay to use SyncViet?
faq.a1: No. Posting, commenting, reacting, following, messaging, and joining communities are completely free.
faq.q2: Is the SyncViet Premium badge the same as Identity Verification?
faq.a2: No. The blue checkmark indicates an active paid SyncViet Premium membership. Identity verification and staff badges are strictly separate.
faq.q3: What happens if I extend my Premium plan before it expires?
faq.a3: Your new duration is added directly onto your existing expiration timestamp so you never lose a single remaining day.
faq.q4: Can I withdraw or transfer my Advertising Balance to another user?
faq.a4: No. Advertising Balance is strictly a prepaid credit balance for SyncViet advertising services and cannot be withdrawn or transferred between accounts.
